passage: Last weekend, I went on a trip to Brighton with my family. The temperature was pleasantly warm, perfect for walking along the beach. We stayed in a hostel where our room was located downstairs, which was great because we didn't have to climb stairs with our heavy suitcases. On our first evening, we discovered a talented guitarist performing near the pier. His music was so relaxing that we stayed to listen for over an hour. For breakfast the next morning, we had boiled eggs and fresh fruit. I was willing to try surfing, an activity I'd never done before, but my brother was hesitant. This caused a brief argument about what to do that day. Eventually, we agreed to split up: I went to the surfing school, while he visited the local museum with our parents. Later, we all met up and shared our exciting stories. It was an enjoyable and memorable trip, teaching me the value of trying new things and compromising with family.
